title: Cross-package source-relative imports break nominal error identity and map to -32603 in compiled distribution
evidence: packages/runner/src/dispatch/session-dispatcher.ts imports JsonRpcMethodNotFoundError and JsonRpcInvalidParamsError from '../../../protocol/src/index.ts' rather than '@durable-zero/protocol'. When executed against compiled @durable-zero/protocol transport, 'err instanceof JsonRpcInvalidParamsError' evaluates to false due to dual module instances in Node ESM. Executable counterexample in probe-nominal-identity.mjs proved that session/prompt with invalid content returns -32603 instead of -32602, and unmapped method returns -32603 instead of -32601.
impact: Severe public protocol contract regression in production runtime and compiled bundles; all dispatcher validation errors and method-not-found errors are misclassified over the wire as internal errors (-32603).

title: createSessionDispatcher factory is omitted from @durable-zero/runner public package export entrypoint
evidence: packages/runner/src/index.ts exports only cli-args, composition, and main; it does not export ./dispatch/index.ts. Furthermore, packages/runner/package.json does not declare a ./dispatch subpath in its exports field. Attempting 'import { createSessionDispatcher } from "@durable-zero/runner"' fails with SyntaxError: The requested module '@durable-zero/runner' does not provide an export named 'createSessionDispatcher'. Verified by probe-nominal-identity.mjs.
impact: Sibling packages and composition root cannot consume createSessionDispatcher via standard package imports, breaking package encapsulation and blocking clean integration into composition.ts.

title: Test suite count discrepancy in author report (claimed 61 tests, actual test runner executed 57 tests)
evidence: Author report claimed 27 protocol conformance tests, 34 capability dispatch tests, and 61 combined tests (repeated in report.json). However, packages/protocol/test/protocol-conformance.test.ts contains exactly 23 test cases (5 in Defect 1, 6 in Defect 2, 9 in Defect 3, 3 in Defect 4). Running both test files via node --test outputs 'tests 57, pass 57', matching junit.xml 'tests 57'.
impact: Inaccurate test inventory metrics undermine audit receipts and verification integrity.

title: Dispatcher RED artifact capability-dispatch-red.log is an unlabeled truncated excerpt with manual headers
evidence: The file has manually prepended comment headers and is 7,554 bytes, truncating abruptly after the 4th failure instead of the full ~32,611 byte output for all 34 assertion failures. It lacks an explicit label designating it as an excerpt. While BB command receipt at seq328 confirms a genuine behavioral RED occurred, the saved log is incomplete without an excerpt disclaimer.
impact: Incomplete RED log creates ambiguity for independent auditors regarding whether execution completed or terminated prematurely.

title: File line budget exceeded in packages/runner/src/dispatch/session-dispatcher.ts (300 LOC > 250 LOC Baseline)
evidence: packages/runner/src/dispatch/session-dispatcher.ts contains 300 lines of code, exceeding the AP-019 baseline of 250 LOC.
impact: Maintainability smell; mixes prompt extraction helpers with method routing switch.

title: Numeric conversationId rejected with JsonRpcInvalidParamsError, narrowing contracts schema
evidence: session-dispatcher.ts strictly enforces 'typeof params.conversationId === "string"', rejecting numeric values like { conversationId: 1 } with code -32602. In contrast, conversationIdSchema in @durable-zero/contracts/src/wire-context.ts:3 defines z.union([z.number().int().positive(), z.string().regex(/^[1-9]\d*$/)]).
impact: Clients or tests passing numeric conversation IDs (native representation in @earendil-works/pi-durable) receive -32602 Invalid params rather than being coerced to string '1'.
